translator_note: Early field conversations with the Shinsengumi, Sakamoto and Sacchan.

english: Don't tell me...\nThey're back here AGAIN!?
That'd make you the toughest\nAND the worst, Kagura...
That worries you too, huh?\nAnother pirate crew\nfighting Harusame...
We only just got home!\nAnd it's already night...

translator_note: Field conversations, Gin Tama tutorials and the Sacchan encounter.

english: Y-you're... G-Gin!?\fOops! Masochist mode\njust switched on!
How cruel! I adore you,\nbut you're so cold...\fKeep that up and I might\nswitch to assassin mode...
Hey, four eyes! Girls hate\nthat sort of comeback!
No! Even for you, Gin,\nI can't do that!

I'm sorry! I can't obey
the man I love... What a bad girl I am!
But I can't give up
this orb!
A contest? To see if\nI can win your heart?
Say what you like!\nThat's a woman in love!
I guess I've no choice.\nI'm still a professional!\fMasochist mode paused!\fHere I come, Gin!\fAssassin mode on!
Shinpachi, what's your\nhead for?\fJust holding up your\nfan club headband?
Use that brain!\nThere is one in there, right!?
No, Kagura. That's\na much lower life form.
Right! The nurse who tried\nto feed me boiling oden\nwhen I couldn't move!
No, Kagura. You're wrong.\fShinpachi still has\nhis glasses!
Leave the orb and\nI won't tell the cops.
So leave it and scram.\fI'll even forget\nabout that boiling oden.
Ugh. What a pain...\nFine. Let's settle this.
Who gets that rare orb?\fWe'll settle it\nwith a Gin Tama battle!\fYou're on,\nassassin Sacchan!
Pickling paste is more use\nthan that useless brain!
A cheat sheet?\nWhat's that? Is it tasty?
Ow! What was that for?!\fI'll jam my thumbs up\nyour nose till the snot\ncomes pouring out!
Seaweed! This woman's\nbrain is made of seaweed!
I tried. I still don't get it.
Gin, what are you saying?!\nShe's that... you know!\fThe ninja!\nAyame Sarutobi!
You should listen to Gin.\fThe Shinsengumi just\nran past here, you know.
Really?! A woman in love\nhas a brain made\nof seaweed?!
That's how battles go.\nGive up on the Dragon Tama.\nBut don't give up on me!
So, friends who\njust can't give up...\nGive it another try!
Yeah! The Dragon Tama\nwas right there!
If you'd like to help\nour useless Gin,\nplease try again!
Defeated. Assassin mode off.\fAnd I needed that\nDragon Tama so badly...
I've done my best,\na lone woman working\nas a freelance assassin...
I couldn't go on like this.\nThen I heard the rumor...

Everyone's desperate
for Dragon Tama, right? If I could get one,
someone would pay
a fortune for it...
They'd be happy,\nand I could buy food!\fSee? A three way win win!
Thank you!\nI knew you loved me too...!

I'll never forget this!
One day I'll return
your love! Until then...
Adios, mi amore!

Listen closely, you idiot. Say somebody buys
seven stolen Dragon Tama
from you. You think that would
grant their wish?
No! Hell no!\fAll the stolen orbs\nin the world won't\ngrant your wish!

Listen. If Dragon Tama
really do grant wishes... It isn't because
the orbs themselves
have magic powers.
You've found real treasure.\nDon't lose it.\f...See ya.
How the hell did you\nget that idea...?
We worked our asses off\nfor this precious orb!\fWhy the hell should\nwe give it to the cops?
Finally got one!\nWho'd give up all\nthat hard work?\fStill more to go...
Home, Kagura.\nLeave the idiot.\fGot a Dragon Tama!\nKelp's on me.
Why not tell us?\nMaybe we can help.
That's two ways.\nAnd that's not even\na real saying.
...Shall we go too?\nWe need to hand that\nDragon Tama to the police.
What? But you just said\nwhat really matters...
Can't help it, I guess.\nThat's Gin for you...
I hope they don't\nget in too deep...\f...Though I suppose\nthat's inevitable.
Like arming terrorists.\fTime to crack down.
Not the point!\fYou work cases,\nbut don't know?!
Even a gorilla gets it.\fKondo too.
Ask Matsudaira?\fWe need a Gin Tama\ntask force...
We make do with our lot.
So, Gin Tama are just orbs?
About that...\nI need to ask you something.
We've had a lot of\nGin Tama trouble lately.
We need a special\nGin Tama unit...
No, that's because\nwe take our duties\nseriously, day and night...
What?! Then we'd be\nworking for free\nfor the next ten years!

Oh, that craze
everyone's talking about? My daughter's
obsessed with it too... So...
What about Gin Tama?
Hm? A favor?\fIt'd better not be stupid.\nYou know what'll happen.
